nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, set from msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner access-control modifier.
Pending owner address; written by transferOwnership and promoted to owner by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string (WEONECOIN), mutable only by the owner via setSymbol.
Public token name string (WeOneCoin Token), mutable only by the owner via setName.
Token decimals (18), set once in the constructor.
Total token supply (1e27), assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account address to token balance; read and written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and the constructor.
Nested mapping owner => spender => allowance; written by approve and approveAndCall, decremented in transferFrom.
Internal pure helper multiplying two uint256 values with an overflow assert.
Internal pure helper performing integer division with truncation.
Internal pure helper subtracting two uint256 values, asserting b <= a to prevent underflow.
Internal pure helper adding two uint256 values, asserting the result does not overflow.
onlyOwner function that stages a pending owner in newOwner.
Verifies msg.sender equals newOwner and promotes newOwner to owner, emitting OwnershipTransferred.
WeOneCoinERC20Token constructor initialising symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-minting the entire supply.
Returns _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
Executes whether the caller sending value to this contract has enough balance to send value to this contract.
ERC20 transfer that debits balances[msg.sender] with safeSub and credits balances[to] with safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens and emits Approval.
Debits balances[from], decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to].
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract, making an external call to an untrusted address.
Payable fallback function that accepts ether without any logic.
onlyOwner function performing an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer call to a caller-supplied token contract.
onlyOwner function overwriting the name state variable.
onlyOwner function overwriting the symbol state variable.
onlyOwner function that destroys the contract with selfdestruct(owner).
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, access-control checks, balances and allowances.
selfdestruct(owner) inside kill permanently removes the contract and forwards its ether to owner.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an untrusted, attacker-controlled contract with attacker-supplied data.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied token contract.
Balance subtraction balances[msg.sender] - tokens executed in transfer; relies on SafeMath assert for underflow protection.
Balance/allowance subtraction in transferFrom; relies on SafeMath assert for underflow protection.
First uint256 operand of the SafeMath helpers safeMul/safeDiv/safeSub/safeAdd.
Second uint256 operand of the SafeMath helpers safeMul/safeDiv/safeSub/safeAdd.
Candidate owner address passed to transferOwnership and stored in newOwner.
Caller-supplied contract address used as the external callee in transferAnyERC20Token.
Token amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer in transferAnyERC20Token.
Address whose balance or allowance is queried in balanceOf and allowance.
Spender address used as the second key when reading allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Recipient address credited in transfer.
Amount of tokens debited/credited in transfer.
Spender address granted an allowance in approve.
Allowance amount written to allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
Debited source address in transferFrom.
Credited recipient address in transferFrom.
Token amount moved in transferFrom, subtracted from balance and allowance.
Spender contract address granted an allowance and then called via receiveApproval.
Allowance amount granted and forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary bytes payload forwarded to the untrusted spender contract.
New name string supplied by the owner to setName.
New symbol string supplied by the owner to setSymbol.
Local variable holding the unchecked product a * b inside safeMul.
Local variable holding the truncated quotient a / b inside safeDiv.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Owned constructor, establishing the privileged account.
transferOwnership stores the caller-supplied _newOwner into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes the pending newOwner value into owner.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable under the onlyOwner modifier.
acceptOwnership writes the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after promotion.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership requires msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates the privileged transferAnyERC20Token function.
onlyOwner modifier gates the setName metadata mutation.
onlyOwner modifier gates the setSymbol metadata mutation.
onlyOwner modifier gates the destructive kill function.
caller-controlled msg.sender is used to read and write the balances mapping.
caller-controlled msg.sender is used as a key into the allowed allowance mapping.
owner is passed as the beneficiary of the selfdestruct call in kill.
kill executes selfdestruct(owner), destroying the contract.
The constructor initialises _totalSupply to 1e27.
The constructor pre-mints the whole supply into the fixed deployer address in balances.
The constructor sets the symbol state variable.
The constructor sets the name state variable.
The constructor sets the decimals state variable to 18.
transfer performs the balances[msg.sender] - tokens subtraction that SafeMath protects against underflow.
transfer debits and credits entries of the balances mapping.
The caller-supplied tokens parameter flows into the balance subtraction in transfer.
transferFrom performs two subtractions (balance and allowance) guarded only by SafeMath asserts.
The from parameter determines which balance is decremented in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the amount subtracted from balance and allowance in transferFrom.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] by the transferred amount.
approve writes the allowance entry allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowance before performing the external call.
approveAndCall executes an external call to the untrusted spender contract after updating state.
The untrusted spender executes receiveApproval and can re-enter the token contract from inside the external call.
The spender parameter is the target contract invoked by receiveApproval.
The tokens parameter is forwarded as an argument to the external receiveApproval call.
The arbitrary data parameter is forwarded to the untrusted callee.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external ERC20 transfer call on a caller-supplied token contract.
The arbitrary tokenAddress contract executes code during the external transfer call, returning control to transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokenAddress parameter selects the external contract that is called.
The tokens parameter is forwarded to the external transfer call that sends tokens to owner.
setName overwrites the name state variable with an owner-supplied string.
setSymbol overwrites the symbol state variable with an owner-supplied string.
The _value parameter of setName is stored directly into name.
The _value parameter of setSymbol is stored directly into symbol.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner] using the caller-supplied address.
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender] using caller-supplied addresses.
allowance reads from the allowed mapping.
transfer credits the balances entry of the to parameter.
transferFrom credits the balances entry of the to parameter.
approve writes the allowance keyed by the spender parameter.
approve stores the tokens parameter as the allowance value.
safeMul computes the local product c = a * b before validating it with an assert.
safeDiv computes the local quotient c = a / b returned by the function.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a is only meaningful as the operand of the SafeMath helpers, so it is folded into safeMul.
Parameter b is the second SafeMath operand and is folded into safeMul.
_newOwner exists solely to set the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership.
tokenAddress only serves as the callee of the external ERC20 transfer call.
tokens in transferAnyERC20Token only feeds the external transfer call.
tokenOwner is only used to index balances in balanceOf.
spender is only used to index the allowed mapping in allowance.
to is only the credited recipient of transfer.
tokens in transfer is the amount subtracted from balances[msg.sender] by safeSub.
spender is only the allowance key written by approve.
tokens is the allowance value stored by approve.
from selects the balance decremented via safeSub in transferFrom.
to is only the credited recipient of transferFrom.
tokens is the amount removed from balance and allowance via safeSub in transferFrom.
spender is the target contract of the receiveApproval external call in approveAndCall.
tokens is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
data is the arbitrary payload forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
_value is only written into the name state variable by setName.
_value is only written into the symbol state variable by setSymbol.
Local c is the intermediate product computed and checked inside safeMul.
Local c is the intermediate quotient computed and returned inside safeDiv.
